revealWordProblem.title: Apply: A Game of Golf
revealWordProblem.text: Golf scores are measured as strokes over or under par. Par is the number of golf strokes considered necessary to get the ball in the hole, so a score under par is written as a negative integer and a score over par is written as a positive integer. The scorecard shows six players' scores relative to par after seven holes of a 9-hole round (par = 35): Evelyn -2, Brielle +1, Terrance 0, Reginald -3, Sofia +4, Francisco +2. Order the six scores from least to greatest to rank the players from first place (the current leader) to last place. Who is winning after 7 holes, and who has the most strokes to make up?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A golf score card with par equal to 35, showing six players' scores and how far each is over or under par.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: From least to greatest, the scores are -3, -2, 0, +1, +2, +4, which ranks the players Reginald, Evelyn, Terrance, Brielle, Francisco, Sofia. Reginald is winning after 7 holes because -3 is the least score — it is farthest left on the number line, meaning he used the fewest strokes compared to par. Sofia is in last place because +4 is the greatest score, farthest right on the number line, meaning she has used the most strokes over par.

reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Compare and Order Integers is thinking that a negative number with a bigger digit is the bigger value — for example, believing -15 is greater than -8 because 15 is greater than 8. It's the opposite for negatives: the number farther to the left on the number line (farther from zero) is always the LESSER value, so -15 < -8. Before you submit, check your comparison against the number line, not just the digits.

hintsEs: De menor a mayor es lo mismo que de izquierda a derecha en la recta numérica.
Dibuja una recta numérica con el 0 en el medio y coloca cada valor: los negativos van a la izquierda del 0 y los positivos a la derecha.
Coloca primero -7 y -3: el que esté más a la izquierda va antes en la lista. Luego decide dónde caen 0 y 2 después de ellos.

level3.stem: Three buried chests sit at -9 m, -4 m, and -15 m below sea level. Which chest is at the GREATEST elevation (closest to the surface)?
level3.explanation: Closer to zero means greater for negatives. -4 is only 4 below the surface, so -4 is the greatest of -9, -4, and -15.
choiceFeedback: For negative numbers, greater means closer to zero—-4 is only 4 units down, not 9.
The greatest negative number is closest to zero, not farthest away from it.
These three depths are all different—check how far each one is from sea level (zero).
level3.stemEs: Tres cofres enterrados están a -9 m, -4 m y -15 m bajo el nivel del mar. ¿Cuál cofre está a la MAYOR elevación (más cerca de la superficie)?
level3.explanationEs: Estar más cerca de cero significa ser mayor entre los negativos. -4 está solo 4 debajo de la superficie, así que -4 es el mayor de -9, -4 y -15.
hints: Greater always means farther right on the number line, even when every value is negative.
Among negative numbers, the one closest to zero is the greatest, so compare how far below the surface each chest sits.
Line the depths up in order: -15 is farthest left, then -9, then -4. Now decide which end of that line is the greatest elevation.
hintsEs: Mayor siempre significa más a la derecha en la recta numérica, incluso cuando todos los valores son negativos.
Entre los números negativos, el más cercano a cero es el mayor, así que compara qué tan abajo de la superficie está cada cofre.
Ordena las profundidades: -15 está más a la izquierda, luego -9 y luego -4. Ahora decide cuál extremo de esa recta es la mayor elevación.

level3.stem: On the map, a sunken lantern is at -8 m and a coral shelf is at -3 m. Which symbol makes the comparison true:  -8 ___ -3 ?
level3.explanation: -8 is farther left (deeper) than -3, so -8 is less than -3. The symbol is <.
choiceFeedback: The negative number farther from zero is less than the one closer to zero—-8 < -3.
Check the position of each number on the number line—-8 is left of -3.
-8 and -3 are not equal—they are different distances from zero.
level3.stemEs: En el mapa, una linterna hundida está a -8 m y un arrecife de coral está a -3 m. ¿Cuál símbolo hace verdadera la comparación:  -8 ___ -3 ?
level3.explanationEs: -8 está más a la izquierda (más profundo) que -3, así que -8 es menor que -3. El símbolo es <.
hints: The inequality symbol always opens toward the greater number, and 'less than' means farther left on the number line.
Place both depths on a number line: deeper underwater means farther left, which means a smaller value.
The lantern sits 8 below the surface and the shelf sits 3 below. Decide which one is farther left, then pick the symbol that points at it.
hintsEs: El símbolo de desigualdad siempre se abre hacia el número mayor, y 'menor que' significa más a la izquierda en la recta numérica.
Coloca las dos profundidades en una recta numérica: más profundo bajo el agua significa más a la izquierda, es decir, un valor menor.
La linterna está 8 debajo de la superficie y el arrecife está 3 debajo. Decide cuál está más a la izquierda y luego elige el símbolo que apunta hacia él.

tool.intro: Drag both points to compare integers. The one farther right is greater — even when a more-negative number is farther from zero.
